turns.text: I want to learn an instrument this year and I'm torn between a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is guitar, which I could use to play songs with friends around a fire.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's piano, which my neighbor says is the best way to learn music theory.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is drums, really fun but loud, and I live in an apartment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What kind of music do you want to play? If it's singing along with friends, guitar is the way to go. If you want a deeper understanding of music, piano is a fantastic start.
